text: Assessment of the Potential of Decentralized Dinance (DeFi) as an Alternative to Traditional Financial Services in the Context of the Development of the Digital Economy and Web3 presents the following source proposition: Particular attention is paid to the analysis of such advantages of DeFi as open access to financial products, transaction transparency, process automation based on smart contracts, and the reduction of dependence on centralized intermediaries.
